# Khatib Designs

> Khatib Designs is an Arabic-first product and AI studio based in Kuwait, serving Kuwait, the UAE and the wider GCC. It designs and builds mobile apps, web platforms and AI systems — assistants, workflow automation and Arabic chatbots — for businesses. Founded in 2015, with 100+ products shipped across six countries.

- Book a free 30-minute get-to-know call: https://khatibdesigns.com/book/ (Arabic: https://khatibdesigns.com/ar/book/)
- Email: studio@khatibdesigns.com · WhatsApp: +965 5000 3048
- Founder: Nader Al-Khatib, enterprise AI consultant — https://khatibdesigns.com/nader/ (Arabic: https://khatibdesigns.com/ar/nader/)
- Every page exists in English and Arabic (Arabic under /ar/).

## AI consultancy (priced)

- [AI consultancy in Kuwait & the GCC](https://khatibdesigns.com/ai/) (Arabic: https://khatibdesigns.com/ar/ai/): assess → build → support.
  - AI Readiness & Governance Sprint: KWD 3,500 fixed, 3 weeks — governance model, ranked roadmap and one working agent in production. A single-workflow version for smaller businesses: KWD 1,500.
  - The Build: from KWD 7,000, typically 6–12 weeks — multiple workflows in production, systems connected.
  - AI Operations: KWD 2,500/month — monitoring, tuning, new workflows and a monthly plain-language report.
  - The Sprint maps governance against CITRA Resolution 26 of 2024.
- [AI for Dubai & the UAE](https://khatibdesigns.com/dubai/) (Arabic: https://khatibdesigns.com/ar/dubai/): Arabic-first AI for UAE businesses.

### What we won't do

- We won't sell you a model. We build the unglamorous plumbing around it, which is where these projects actually fail.
- We won't put AI in front of your customers before it's ready. If it isn't better than what you do now, we'll say so and stop.
- We won't hide behind a pilot. Two weeks, live, or you don't pay.

## Product design & development

- [Services](https://khatibdesigns.com/#services): iOS, Android and web products, UX/UI design, MVPs.
- [Case studies](https://khatibdesigns.com/work/)
  - [Connect Here](https://khatibdesigns.com/work/connect-here/) (Arabic: https://khatibdesigns.com/ar/work/connect-here/): venue-based social networking app, iOS and Android.
  - [iWASH](https://khatibdesigns.com/work/iwash/) (Arabic: https://khatibdesigns.com/ar/work/iwash/): on-demand car-wash platform, Kuwait.
  - [Spotly](https://khatibdesigns.com/work/spotly/) (Arabic: https://khatibdesigns.com/ar/work/spotly/): bilingual family-outing discovery app for Kuwait with AI place screening.
  - [Safey](https://khatibdesigns.com/work/safey/) (Arabic: https://khatibdesigns.com/ar/work/safey/): encrypted iOS vault with break-in alerts.
  - [DWA](https://khatibdesigns.com/work/dwa/) (Arabic: https://khatibdesigns.com/ar/work/dwa/): pharmacy delivery platform.
  - [Coines](https://khatibdesigns.com/work/coines/) (Arabic: https://khatibdesigns.com/ar/work/coines/): peer-to-peer crypto exchange app.
  - [WCS](https://khatibdesigns.com/work/wcs/) (Arabic: https://khatibdesigns.com/ar/work/wcs/): management system for US steel factories.
  - [PrintIt](https://khatibdesigns.com/work/printit/) (Arabic: https://khatibdesigns.com/ar/work/printit/): on-demand printing marketplace.
  - [LUMA](https://khatibdesigns.com/work/luma/) (Arabic: https://khatibdesigns.com/ar/work/luma/): puzzle game on the App Store and Google Play.
